scientific_integrity: Analytic sign and zero-count proof supplemented by a symbolic and high-precision parameter checker. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to endpoint-to-endpoint spectral fractional heat on the unweighted four-path. Does not classify whole-matrix entrywise positivity, weighted graphs, or elementary closed forms for nonzero crossing times.
title: Two order transitions in endpoint positivity for four-site fractional graph heat
